description: Run the project's GUT or GdUnit4 tests in Godot 4.7 headless and return only the totals and the failing tests, each with res://file:line and the failure message, plus script errors from the run. Use it after a change to see whether the tests still pass. Needs Godot on this machine and GUT (res://addons/gut) or GdUnit4 (res://addons/gdUnit4) in the project. `framework` picks one when both are installed; `dirs` chooses the test folders or scripts (default: the framework's config, else res://test and res://tests); `filter` runs only matching GUT tests. An error result when a test fails, or when Godot or a framework is missing. Test files are not changed; reports go to a temporary folder or .godot/godotwright/. To try input without writing tests use godot_play; for load errors only use godot_check.

dirs.description: test folders or scripts as res:// paths (default: the framework's config, else res://test and res://tests)

filter.description: GUT only: run only tests whose name contains this text

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

name: godot_test
title: Run the unit tests
